summary: This note describes Lake County, Oregon, located in the high desert region known as the Oregon Outback on the northwestern edge of the Great Basin. It states that the county is generally divided into a southern area centered on Lakeview and Paisley and a northern area around Christmas Valley, Fort Rock, and Silver Lake.
one_line: Lake County, Oregon is a high desert county in the Oregon Outback on the northwestern edge of the Great Basin.
key_facts: Lake County is located in the high desert region known as the Oregon Outback.
Lake County lies on the northwestern edge of the Great Basin.
The county is generally divided between communities around Lakeview and Paisley to the south.
The county is generally divided between communities around Christmas Valley, Fort Rock, and Silver Lake to the north.
